newsitem.title: FRANCE: DMC up on chairman's remarks.
newsitem.headline: DMC up on chairman's remarks.

text.p: Shares in French textile company DMC rose sharply on Monday as investors were encouraged by chairman Jacques Boubal's remarks in an interview with the weekly Journal des Finances, brokers said.

Boubal said DMC expects to reach breakeven within two years. The group had held its debt this year at around 900 million francs and may even show a reduction of 50 million to 100 million francs by year-end, he said.
The share was six percent higher at 114.40 francs in late trading, but some analysts said they remained wary. "It's too early to come back to this stock," one analyst said.
The analyst said the rise appeared to be a technical rebound in the stock after a long slide from its year-high of 284 francs set in April.
"It should remain near its lows because it takes a long time before restructurings are reflected in the share price."
DMC shares hit a year low of 107 francs earlier this month.
Another analyst said he considered the stock speculative. "There's no proof that the company will turn around," he said.
